# Registrations survive a restart; the acceptors' state sync corrects them (spec 02 §2).
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin home 04000009 player=9
coin away 04000003 player=3
restart
expect regs home=7,9 away=3,_
# While the server was down, 9 took the coins out with the button and 4 came to the away side.
held home
held away 04000003=3 04000004=4
expect regs home=7*,9* away=3,4
